philosophy: Universal Cultural Intelligence — grounded, documentary, human, editorial.

deepObsidian.usage: Dark mode primary surface, reels theater canvas, cinema views.

lapisIndigo.name: Knowledge Indigo
lapisIndigo.usage: Maps, intelligence networks, enterprise data interfaces.

sageMineral.usage: Ecological stewardship, DPDP compliance badge, living traditions.

amberBeacon.name: Dawn Amber

watermarkPolicy.details: No user-facing visual may display Gemini, Google, or any AI tool watermark, placeholder artifact, or synthetic distortion. Every asset must have an authentic documentary provenance.
